book.title: Mɓe ɗe Jesu Kristi woo nJoon ndǝǝn Suun

content: Gurum mo Ngal Kambil Mǝndong kǝ Lar FeerBa Feer Ɗeluluwas

Aɓwoon ɗe mbii ɗesǝ mo kyes, ɓe nghan naa nenlep kǝ Naan mo feer, moo ɗar nkoop kwang ɗefeer mǝ yil nǝ, mo yaa kut ɗin nkwang ɗefeer mǝ yil nǝ mo ɗar kǝ nǝ, mbǝkǝ taji mee kut cutpee nkaa yil nǝ, koo nkaa baahar, koo nkaa tǝng mo kas.

Ɗangɓe nghan naa mee ngulep nNaan, ɗe wur kǝ put a nkoop puus kàa, wur kǝ me bii lǝlu Awas pee Naan ɗe kǝ seen nsar wur. Wur pet nenlep ɗefeer nǝ mo shi ɗoo ɗi ɓalɓal ɗe mo shin iiko mo, mbǝkǝ mo tǝkook kǝ yil kǝ am.
Ɓe wur sat nǝnee, <<Taji wu wat yil nǝ, koo baahar nǝ, koo tǝng mo kas. Wu ɗar akuɗang, see mǝ le fili (alaama) mǝ lǝluwas mǝ Naan nkaa pǝkyeen mǝ kǝrem wur mo akuɗang.>>
Ɗangɓe nghan kǝlǝng ɗuu nen ɗǝ mo le fili (alaama) nǝ mo mpǝkyeen mo, mo ngal kambil mǝndong kǝ lar feer baafeer. Nen ɗesǝ nǝ mo put a ndǝǝn koo soon ɗeɗangyi mǝ nen Izrel mo.

content: Ɗuu Gurum mo kǝ nlǝr ɗepiyaa

Aɓwoon ɗesǝ, ɓe wen ool, mbǝ ɗuu gurum mo ɗes, ɗe baa mee gurum mak tang mo kas. Nen ɗesǝ nǝ mo puwat a ndǝǝn yil mo shinǝ-shinǝ, kǝ nkwang soon mo shinǝ-shinǝ, kǝ gurum mo shinǝ-shinǝ, kǝ liispwoo mo shinǝ-shinǝ, kǝ ndǝǝn koo a pee ɗeɗangyi ndǝǝn yil ɗǝsǝ. Mo ɗar ntoom peetong mǝ mulki, kǝ ntoom Laatǝm. Mo jwal lée ɗepiyaa mo, mo kǝ kom kǝkar nsar mo zak.
Mo ɗiyeep ɗoo mo mo ashak shiɓal, nǝnee,

content.text: <<Ɓam tong a pǝ Naan fun,
ɗe wur tong
nkaa peetong mǝ mulki sǝ,
kǝ Laatǝm nǝ.>>

content: Nenlep mo jir, moo ɗar atǝng neer peetong mǝ mulki nǝ, kǝ nennan sǝ mo, kǝ mbǝ ɗefeer ɗe mo kǝ seen sǝ mo zak. Nenlep nǝ mo saam kǝ yit fur nyil ntoom peetong mǝ mulki nǝ, kǝ mo seyil nNaan.

content.text: <<Nǝ aasǝ, kwoop, kǝ ɗehai, kǝ seen,
kǝ pǝlang, kǝ ɗǝɗes, kǝ iiko,
kǝ ɓal, mo ɗee a mǝ Naan fun
mbǝ ngaa-ngaa, Nǝ aasǝ.>>

content: Ɗangɓe memee mɓut nennan nǝ mo wur tal pǝ an ɗi, ɓe wur sat nǝnee, <<Nen ɗǝ mo din nlǝr ɗe piyaa-piyaa sǝ mo awii mo me? Mo pwat a ni jii?>>
Wen lap nwur nǝnee, <<Daa fen, a man.>> Ɗangɓe wur sat nǝnee,

content.text: <<Nen ɗesǝ mo, a nen
ɗe mo pwat ndǝǝn nen
ɗi mo shin keer mo,
mo kǝ vwang lée nmo,
kǝ mo ɗee a ɗepiyaa mo,
ndǝǝn toom Laatǝm.
A mpeemǝnǝ, ɓe moo ɗar ntoom peetong mǝ
mulki Naan,
kǝ moo seyil ndǝǝn Lu Naan ɗǝdes,
mpaar kǝ puus.
Gwar ɗe wur tong nkaa peetong
mǝ mulki nǝ,
wur tap mo.
Baa neen ncham láa mo kas,
kǝ zak, baa neen am cham tu mo kas.
Baa puus, koo tal
kǝ puus nǝn
cham mo kas.
Laatǝm ɗe wur nnaar
peetong mǝ mulki nǝ,
wur nɗeen a ngukiyeer mo.
Wur dǝm kǝ mo a pee tuɓut
ɗe nǝ a mǝ seen.
Naan wur mpwes
yitmwaan mo jir.>>
